title: Rhythm without recruitment: analysis code, derived data and verification
description: Analysis and verification code, derived result files and figure scripts accompanying the preprint 'Rhythm without recruitment: a falsification-first audit of a connectome-constrained ventral nerve cord model as a controller for a simulated Drosophila body' (Yupeng Ning, 2026). The repository re-derives every number and figure of the paper from saved simulation results of the published MANC rate model (Pugliese et al.), including a re-analysis of all 128 author-saved parameter sets, a full-network integrator convergence test, and a 53-item check of the manuscript's quantitative claims.
